name: Dumbbell Side Plank Rear Delt Fly
steps: Set up in a side plank on one forearm with hips lifted straight and feet stacked or staggered.
Hold the dumbbell in your top hand and reach toward the floor in front of your chest with your elbow slightly bent.
Sweep the dumbbell out and up until it aligns above your top shoulder, then lower along the same arc.
Lower your hips with control, then switch sides and repeat.
tips: Keep your chest facing sideways and hips lifted throughout the fly.
Push firmly through your supporting forearm to keep that shoulder active and away from your ear.
